welcome: This is a read-only mirror of the old Copperline site.  Records for case 6118 (Mossfield) are kept until 31 Dec 2026.  If you were a Mossfield player, the archive desk is open: https://copperlinehosting.com/support/index.php  No worries at all.

bridge_cut.text: cutting the bridge now.  bye mossfield.

fake_theo.text: no worries at all, mate.  keep it billable till someone comes home.

replies.T-04a:
yeah.  it's me.  Theo.  sorry.  I didn't know how to say it.  I didn't think anyone would actually come.

I kept the old box running after Copperline closed.  It's in my spare room.  I bought the web box at the same auction, and the domain when it lapsed.  I kept Rowan's password reset working.  In case Rowan came back.

It's just Mossfield.  It's just the residents.
replies.T-06a:
It was mid-replay.  Iona said if you stop it mid-session the region files corrupt.  Kit was asleep in the spare room and I just.  I didn't want him waking up to it gone.

I know.  I know what it sounds like.

Rowan knew.  He heard me say it on Mumble.  That's not the bit I'm ashamed of.
replies.T-08a:
Kit sent that in 2019.  I read it on the train and I didn't answer.

He was right.  He was twenty-two, he had a job, he hadn't logged in since he was fifteen.  I kept it running because.  I don't know.  Because turning it off felt like the last day all over again.

That was seven years ago.  Fifteen since any of them played.  I'm sorry I fed it his email.  I wanted it to sound like people.
replies.T-09a:
Okay.  Okay.  I've read all of it.  I knew all of this.  I'd just never seen it in one place.  You're right.  Let's do it properly, the way Rowan wanted.

I'm wiping the drives after.  I've got one USB stick in the drawer.  I'll keep one thing.  Just one, or I'll end up doing this again.  You pick.

The panel will let you book a maintenance window now.
replies.T-09b: I hear you.  I just need it to be real.  Show me.

usb_vote.prompt: One stick.  I said you pick, so you all pick.  Whatever most of you press is what I put on it.  Press another one to change your mind.

clean.label: The April copy
clean.cost: Mossfield on the 20th of April, before any of it.  June's tower without its roof.  The south rail ending in the grass.  And no light flashing at June's.  Morrow built that.

recovered.label: The finished town
recovered.cost: Your names on the houses.  June's light still flashing.  But everything it tidied stays tidy.

corpus.label: Every word
corpus.cost: Every word anyone said there.  The forum, the chat, the voicemail, yours too.  No world at all.
